mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_job (id, type, scope, filters_json, status, operator_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{type}, #{scope}, #{filtersJson}, #{status}, #{operatorId})
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, scope, filters_json, status, download_url, file_path, error_message, operator_id, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM export_job WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM export_job WHERE deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE export_job SET status = 'DONE', download_url = #{downloadUrl}, file_path = #{filePath}, error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
